card-title: What we have learned about this product
summary-no-data: No delivery data yet. Conclusions appear here once results are imported.
summary-insufficient: There is delivery data, but not enough to draw a conclusion yet.
plan-results-empty: No delivery data was imported for this round.
card-intro: Import delivery results and each element in the image (people or not, which scene, which copy) is compared one by one; a conclusion appears only when there is enough data.
load-error: The conclusions could not be loaded.
forbidden: You do not have access to this workspace's conclusions.
no-data-body: There are no conclusions here yet. Import the ads' impressions, clicks, spend and purchases to see which elements work.
review-signals-note: These are weak signals from human review, not delivery data
next-round: Generate the next round from these conclusions
next-round-hint: Drafts a new test plan that keeps the winning elements, skips the losing ones and keeps one direction for exploration.
next-round-disabled: Not enough data for a usable conclusion yet
next-round-created: The next round's plan is being drafted: {{winners}} winning elements kept, {{losers}} losing elements skipped.
next-round-failed: The next round's plan could not be created: {{message}}
axis-cpa-note: Lower CPA is better: further right means cheaper
axis-ctr-note: Further right means a higher click-through rate
unattributable-title: Data for {{count}} images is saved but cannot be attributed to elements yet
method-note: Each value is compared with the other values of the same element: CTR uses Wilson / ratio intervals and CPA uses per-image resampling intervals; a conclusion needs at least {{impressions}} impressions, {{clicks}} clicks, {{conversions}} purchases and {{assets}} images per group.
import-intro: Each row is one image's data over a period. Images are matched by the creative codes in the template; you can also upload an Ads Manager export as long as each ad name contains its creative code.
template-download: Download the template (with every creative code of this product)
template-failed: The template could not be created. Try again.
or-paste: Or copy and paste from a spreadsheet
paste-label: Pasted table (the first row is the header)
paste-placeholder: Creative code	Start date	End date	Impressions	Link clicks	Spend	Purchases
currency-label: Currency (used when the table has none)
preview-summary: {{total}} rows: {{importable}} can be imported, {{rejected}} will not be imported.
preview-attributable: Images that can be attributed to elements: {{count}}
preview-replaces: {{count}} rows update data imported earlier for the same period
preview-unattributable: {{count}} rows can be imported but cannot be attributed to elements yet
preview-demo: {{count}} of them belong to demo images (controlled Mock) and are counted separately from real data
preview-reasons: Why rows will not be imported
preview-truncated: Only every row that will not be imported and the first rows that can be imported are listed.
duplicate-notice: This data was imported before and will not be counted twice.
committed: Imported {{count}} rows; the conclusions are updated.
problem-paste_too_large: The pasted content is too long. Upload a file instead.
problem-file_encoding_invalid: The file's encoding was not recognised. Save it as “CSV UTF-8” in Excel.
problem-upload_rejected: The file did not pass validation. Make sure it is a CSV file.
problem-preview_stale: The data changed after the preview and was checked again. Confirm once more.
evidence-notice-sandbox: Meta Sandbox simulated data: for trying the workflow only; it does not represent real delivery results
evidence-notice-mock: Demo data: these images were made by controlled Mock; conclusions are for trying the workflow only and do not represent real delivery results
